title: Ledger sharding / evidence cache
root_cause: The current append path republishes a full 39 MB materialized snapshot for a 101 MB ledger and validation has unacceptable time and memory cost.
source_requirement: Migrate to bounded immutable segments/hot projections/content roots only as justified by PX-LEDGER-001, while keeping old ledger verifiable.
implementation_steps: Choose the smallest benchmark-justified segmented/hot-projection design.
Add compact global head/root and revision-scoped projections/cache.
Produce migration receipt binding old head, segments, new root, count, order, and recovery.
Run old/new equivalence and crash/concurrency tests.
negative_cases: Hot projection treated as canonical history.
affected_tests: Operational gap ledger, work admission, evidence custody, release preflight/certification tests.
evidence_required: Migration custody receipt, equivalence proof, benchmark delta, and recovery matrix.
rollback: Switch readers back to the untouched old ledger/head and invalidate new cache/projections; never delete old events.
acceptance_criteria: Old ledger remains fully verifiable with identical count/order.
Cache keys bind every declared revision and authority input.
